notes: The three new themes are colour changes only. They were also changing typeface, corner shape, row height and label case — which is what an installed design system does, not a palette. The rule was already written down and this build did…
They move to Glamour, where a recolour belongs, and their descriptions no longer promise changes they do not make.
Card buttons sit below the thumbnail instead of on top of it. A thumbnail shows whatever that panel actually looks like, so no amount of shading makes a button reliably readable over it.
The Control Panel opens at the size you set.
